plugins.name: AMOLED Black
plugins.author: Yoke
plugins.description: Turns the dark theme pure black, which looks great on OLED screens. Light mode isn't changed.

plugins.name: Compact Sidebar
plugins.author: Yoke
plugins.description: Tightens the sidebar so more of your playlists fit without scrolling.

plugins.name: Intro Scan
plugins.author: Yoke
plugins.description: Like the button on an old CD player: press I to hear the first 15 seconds of each song in the queue.

plugins.name: Listening Time
plugins.author: Yoke
plugins.description: Shows how long you've listened today and this week, under your song count in the sidebar.

plugins.name: Sleep Timer
plugins.author: Yoke
plugins.description: Adds a moon button that stops the music after 15, 30, 60 or 90 minutes, fading out gently.
